task: Collect like terms
formula: axⁿ + bxⁿ = (a+b)xⁿ
condition: Only combine matching variables AND powers.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Collect like terms. The blue terms have the same variable part, x squared, so their coefficients combine: three minus one leaves two."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="24" y="29" width="120" height="55" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="24" y="100" width="120" height="55" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="154" y1="56" x2="191" y2="91" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="154" y1="127" x2="191" y2="91" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="191" y1="91" x2="230" y2="91" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M222.97933950487703,94.83540430883363 L230,91 L222.97933950487703,87.16459569116637" stroke="#3175ba" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="243" y="61" width="125" height="60" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="107.4" y="69.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">3x²</text><text x="107.4" y="129.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">−x²</text><text x="295.25" y="99.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">2x²</text><text x="392.15" y="73.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">+4x</text><text x="392.15" y="112.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">stays</text></svg>
narration: The blue terms have the same variable part, x squared, so their coefficients combine: three minus one leaves two. The green four x has a different power and stays separate. Always keep a term’s sign attached when grouping it.

task: Multiply every term by every term
formula: a(b+c)=ab+ac; xᵐxⁿ=xᵐ⁺ⁿ. m terms × n terms → mn products.
condition: Index rule here uses non-negative integer powers.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Multiply every term by every term. Each row term meets each column term once."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="145.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="145.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="225.125" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="356.875" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="101.45" y="78.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">2x</text><text x="223.425" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2x²</text><text x="355.175" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">8x</text><text x="101.45" y="119.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="223.425" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3x</text><text x="355.175" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="240.0" y="157.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">(2x+3)(x+4) → 2x²+11x+12</text></svg>
narration: Each row term meets each column term once. Fill all four cells before collecting the two x terms. Coefficients multiply, while powers of the same variable add. A larger pair of brackets simply needs more rows or columns, with no missing products.

task: Substitute a signed value
formula: Replace each variable by its whole signed value in brackets. Denominator ≠ 0.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Substitute a signed value. The arrow replaces the whole input with minus three in brackets."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="16.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="152.0" y1="83" x2="170.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M162.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L170.0,83 L162.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="174.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="310.0" y1="83" x2="328.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M320.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L328.0,83 L320.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="332.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="105.7" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x = −3</text><text x="240.0" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x²</text><text x="240.0" y="102.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">→ (−3)²</text><text x="374.3" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">9</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Bracket the negative value before squaring.</text></svg>
narration: The arrow replaces the whole input with minus three in brackets. Squaring this bracket multiplies minus three by minus three, giving positive nine. A minus sign outside a square behaves differently. Before evaluating a fraction, check that its denominator is not zero.

task: Keep an equation balanced
formula: Do the same valid operation to BOTH sides; clear every denominator. Never divide by zero.
condition: A multiplier applies to every term on both sides.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Keep an equation balanced. Think of the equation as a balanced beam."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><line x1="95" y1="91" x2="385" y2="91" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="4" /><polygon points="220,145 260,145 240,105" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="68" y="35" width="140" height="45" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="272" y="35" width="140" height="45" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="153.3" y="69.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2x + 3</text><text x="326.7" y="69.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">11</text><text x="153.3" y="122.8" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">−3</text><text x="326.7" y="122.8" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">−3</text><text x="240.0" y="159.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2x = 8  →  x = 4</text></svg>
narration: Think of the equation as a balanced beam. Removing three from both sides keeps it balanced and leaves two x equal to eight. Dividing both sides by two then finds x. When clearing fractions, the same multiplier must reach every term on each side.

task: Match two perimeters
formula: Rectangle P=2L+2W. Set P₁=P₂ when the perimeters are equal.
condition: Equal boundary lengths do not imply equal areas.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Match two perimeters. Trace the outside edge of each rectangle."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="34" y="40" width="180" height="86" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="291" y="25" width="140" height="116" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="141.4" y="40.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">L</text><text x="58.1" y="95.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">W</text><text x="342.85" y="154.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">P₂</text><text x="141.4" y="154.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">P₁</text><text x="249.35" y="98.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="27" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">=</text></svg>
narration: Trace the outside edge of each rectangle. Each length and each width occurs twice, so write two complete perimeter expressions and equate them. The differently shaped interiors remind you that matching perimeter is a boundary condition and says nothing by itself about matching area.

task: Subtract a removed area
formula: Unshaded area = whole area − shaded area.
condition: Use square units; a minus before brackets changes every sign.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Subtract a removed area. The large rectangle gives the whole area."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="45" y="30" width="390" height="119" rx="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="290" y="30" width="145" height="64" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="168.6" y="97.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="27" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">keep</text><text x="344.55" y="75.2" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">remove</text><text x="240.0" y="161.9" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">whole − removed = remaining</text></svg>
narration: The large rectangle gives the whole area. Calculate the amber piece separately, then subtract it to leave the unshaded region. If the removed area is an algebraic expression, keep it in brackets while subtracting so that every term receives the minus sign.

task: Divide every term
formula: (A+B−C)/d=A/d+B/d−C/d; xᵐ/xⁿ=xᵐ⁻ⁿ.
condition: Require d ≠ 0 and x ≠ 0 for the index division rule.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Divide every term. Split the numerator into separate divisions with the same non-zero divisor."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="47" y="64" width="161" height="49" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="271" y="64" width="161" height="49" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="127" y1="117" x2="127" y2="141" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M123.16459569116637,133.97933950487703 L127,141 L130.83540430883363,133.97933950487703" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="351" y1="117" x2="351" y2="141" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M347.16459569116637,133.97933950487703 L351,141 L354.83540430883363,133.97933950487703" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="240.0" y="42.9" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">(6x² + 4x) ÷ 2x</text><text x="143.95" y="96.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">6x² ÷ 2x</text><text x="334.35" y="96.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">4x ÷ 2x</text><text x="143.95" y="156.8" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">3x</text><text x="240.0" y="156.8" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">+</text><text x="334.35" y="156.8" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">2</text></svg>
narration: Split the numerator into separate divisions with the same non-zero divisor. Six x squared divided by two x gives three x; four x divided by two x gives two. Rejoin the results with the original signs. The original expression excludes x equal to zero.

task: Reverse a multiplication grid
formula: Dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder.
condition: Divisor ≠ 0; leave spaces for missing powers.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Reverse a multiplication grid. Read this multiplication grid backwards."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="145.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="145.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="225.125" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="356.875" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="101.45" y="78.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="223.425" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">x²</text><text x="355.175" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3x</text><text x="101.45" y="119.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="223.425" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2x</text><text x="355.175" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="240.0" y="157.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">x²+5x+6 = (x+2)(x+3)</text></svg>
narration: Read this multiplication grid backwards. If x plus two is the divisor, the column headings x and three reconstruct the quotient. Products inside the grid add back to the dividend. For a non-exact division, include a remainder and verify the complete multiplication-and-addition identity.

task: Locate a number family
formula: ℤ ⊂ ℚ ⊂ ℝ; rational numbers are p/q with integers p,q and q≠0.
condition: Recurring decimals are rational; √2 is irrational.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Locate a number family. The nested boxes show that every integer is rational and every rational number is real."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="18" y="20" width="444" height="148" rx="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="35" y="38" width="327" height="117" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="55" y="57" width="210" height="82" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="402.35" y="55.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">ℝ</text><text x="384.5" y="94.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">√2</text><text x="319.9" y="70.1" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">ℚ</text><text x="298.65" y="112.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">½</text><text x="236.6" y="85.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">ℤ</text><text x="223.0" y="115.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">−3</text><text x="148.2" y="107.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">−2, 0, 4</text></svg>
narration: The nested boxes show that every integer is rational and every rational number is real. One half lies in the rational box but outside the integer box. Square root of two lies in the real box outside the rational box. Classification depends on the exact value, not its rounded display.

task: Solve and shade an inequality
formula: Multiply or divide by a negative → reverse <, >, ≤ or ≥.
condition: Adding or subtracting a negative does not reverse the sign.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Solve and shade an inequality. Dividing minus two x greater than or equal to minus six by minus two reverses the inequality."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><line x1="47" y1="95" x2="433" y2="95" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M425.97933950487703,98.83540430883363 L433,95 L425.97933950487703,91.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="65.0" y1="88" x2="65.0" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="152.5" y1="88" x2="152.5" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="240.0" y1="88" x2="240.0" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="327.5" y1="88" x2="327.5" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="415.0" y1="88" x2="415.0" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><circle cx="327.5" cy="95" r="7" fill="#b96a12" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="319.5" y1="95" x2="48" y2="95" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M55.02066049512298,91.16459569116637 L48,95 L55.02066049512298,98.83540430883362" stroke="#b96a12" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="240.0" y="42.9" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">−2x ≥ −6   →   x ≤ 3</text><text x="91.25" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">0</text><text x="165.625" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="240.0" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="314.375" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="388.75" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="240.0" y="156.8" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Filled endpoint: 3 is included.</text></svg>
narration: Dividing minus two x greater than or equal to minus six by minus two reverses the inequality. The result includes every value up to three. A filled dot includes the endpoint, and the arrow points towards all the smaller allowed values on the number line.

task: Take out the highest common factor
formula: HCF = numerical HCF × lowest power common to every term.
condition: Check the remaining bracket for further factors.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Take out the highest common factor. Both terms contain three x."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="35" y="28" width="173" height="54" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="272" y="28" width="173" height="54" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="121" y1="86" x2="240" y2="115" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="358" y1="86" x2="240" y2="115" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="138.85" y="68.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">6x² = 3x · 2x</text><text x="340.3" y="68.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">9x = 3x · 3</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="27" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">6x²+9x = 3x(2x+3)</text></svg>
narration: Both terms contain three x. Dividing six x squared by three x leaves two x, while dividing nine x leaves three. Place those leftovers inside the bracket. Use the lowest shared power, then inspect the bracket to see whether it can be factored again.

task: Group to make matching brackets
formula: ap+aq+bp+bq=(a+b)(p+q).
condition: Taking out a negative factor reverses signs inside its bracket.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Group to make matching brackets. The top row is a times p plus q, and the bottom row is b times the same bracket."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="145.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="145.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="225.125" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">p</text><text x="356.875" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">q</text><text x="101.45" y="78.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">a</text><text x="223.425" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">ap</text><text x="355.175" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">aq</text><text x="101.45" y="119.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">b</text><text x="223.425" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">bp</text><text x="355.175" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">bq</text><text x="240.0" y="157.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Both rows contain the same bracket: (p+q).</text></svg>

task: Recognise a difference of squares
formula: a²−b²=(a−b)(a+b).
condition: Two squares separated by subtraction; not a²+b² over the reals.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Recognise a difference of squares. Start with a square of side a and remove a square of side b."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="50" y="24" width="129" height="129" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="129" y="24" width="50" height="50" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="198" y1="90" x2="244" y2="90" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M236.97933950487703,93.83540430883363 L244,90 L236.97933950487703,86.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="265" y="53" width="179" height="79" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="112.5" y="98.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">a²</text><text x="166.05" y="62.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">b²</text><text x="332.65" y="49.7" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">a+b</text><text x="332.65" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">area = a²−b²</text><text x="332.65" y="150.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">height a−b</text></svg>
narration: Start with a square of side a and remove a square of side b. The remaining area can be rearranged into a rectangle with lengths a minus b and a plus b. This geometric pattern explains why subtraction between two squares produces two conjugate factors.

task: Find two numbers for a monic quadratic
formula: x²+bx+c=(x+p)(x+q): p+q=b, pq=c. x²±2ax+a²=(x±a)².
condition: Check BOTH the sum and the product.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Find two numbers for a monic quadratic. The two inner products contribute three x and two x, adding to five x."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="145.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="145.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="225.125" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="356.875" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="101.45" y="78.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="223.425" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">x²</text><text x="355.175" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3x</text><text x="101.45" y="119.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="223.425" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2x</text><text x="355.175" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="240.0" y="157.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">p=2, q=3: sum 5; product 6.</text></svg>
narration: The two inner products contribute three x and two x, adding to five x. The corner constants multiply to six. That is why the required pair must have both the correct sum and the correct product. When the two constants are equal, the factors form a perfect square.

task: Split the middle term when a ≠ 1
formula: ax²+bx+c: find m+n=b and mn=ac; split bx, then group.
condition: Use ac for the product, rather than c alone.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Split the middle term when a ≠ 1. Here the leading coefficient is two, so search for a pair with sum seven and product six."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="145.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="48" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="145.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="300.0" y="96" width="150.0" height="43" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="225.125" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="356.875" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="101.45" y="78.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">2x</text><text x="223.425" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2x²</text><text x="355.175" y="79.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">6x</text><text x="101.45" y="119.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="223.425" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="355.175" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="240.0" y="157.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2x²+7x+3: split 7x into 6x+x.</text></svg>
narration: Here the leading coefficient is two, so search for a pair with sum seven and product six. Six and one work. The grid shows how six x and one x fill the two middle cells, producing the factors two x plus one and x plus three.

task: Cancel factors and keep restrictions
formula: N/D: factor first, cancel common factors only where original D≠0.
condition: A cancelled denominator factor still creates an excluded input.

Factor the numerator into x minus two times x plus two."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><line x1="240" y1="47" x2="240" y2="70" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M236.16459569116637,62.97933950487702 L240,70 L243.83540430883363,62.97933950487702" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="240.0" y="43.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="29" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">(x²−4)/(x−2)</text><text x="240.0" y="146.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x+2, with x ≠ 2</text><text id="common-numerator" x="143" y="101.55" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">(x−2)</text><text id="remaining-factor" x="236" y="101.55" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">(x+2)</text><text id="fraction-slash" x="292" y="101.55" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">/</text><text id="common-denominator" x="346" y="101.55" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">(x−2)</text><line data-cancel-target="common-numerator" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" x1="104.600" y1="102.164" x2="181.400" y2="85.092" /><line data-cancel-target="common-denominator" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" x1="307.600" y1="102.164" x2="384.400" y2="85.092" /></svg>

task: Factor a cubic before cancelling
formula: Use HCF or grouping → linear factor × quadratic → further factors.
condition: Cancel complete factors, while retaining original exclusions.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Factor a cubic before cancelling. A cubic can become manageable once you extract its common factor."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="16.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="152.0" y1="83" x2="170.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M162.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L170.0,83 L162.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="174.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="310.0" y1="83" x2="328.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M320.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L328.0,83 L320.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="332.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="105.7" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x³+4x²</text><text x="105.7" y="102.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">+3x</text><text x="240.0" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x(x²</text><text x="240.0" y="102.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">+4x+3)</text><text x="374.3" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">x(x+1)</text><text x="374.3" y="102.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">(x+3)</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">First extract x; then factor the quadratic.</text></svg>
narration: A cubic can become manageable once you extract its common factor. Removing x leaves a quadratic, whose constants must add to four and multiply to three. The complete factorisation is x times x plus one times x plus three. Apply this structure before simplifying any fraction.

task: Read membership, subset and size
formula: a∈A: member; B⊆A: every B member is in A; n(A): number of distinct members.
condition: {0} has one member; ∅ has none.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Read membership, subset and size. Set A contains four distinct numbers."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="42" y="22" width="396" height="137" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="68" y="57" width="169" height="77" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="385.35" y="57.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">A</text><text x="115.05" y="87.1" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">B</text><text x="170.3" y="109.2" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">1     2</text><text x="312.25" y="98.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3     4</text><text x="240.0" y="159.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">B ⊆ A; 2 ∈ A; n(A)=4</text></svg>
narration: Set A contains four distinct numbers. The smaller box B holds one and two, and sits entirely within A, so B is a subset of A. Membership describes one element, while cardinality counts the elements. Braces around zero describe a one-element set, not an empty set.

task: Place numbers in nested families
formula: ℕ ⊂ ℤ ⊂ ℚ ⊂ ℝ; irrational = real but not rational.
condition: Use the convention given for whether ℕ includes 0.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Place numbers in nested families. Read the boxes from the inside out: natural numbers sit inside integers, then rational numbers, then real numbers."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="18" y="20" width="444" height="148" rx="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="35" y="38" width="327" height="117" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="55" y="57" width="210" height="82" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="71" y="78" width="116" height="47" rx="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="402.35" y="55.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">ℝ</text><text x="384.5" y="94.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">√2</text><text x="319.9" y="70.1" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">ℚ</text><text x="298.65" y="112.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">½</text><text x="236.6" y="85.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">ℤ</text><text x="223.0" y="115.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">−3</text><text x="145.65" y="106.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">ℕ: 1, 2…</text></svg>
narration: Read the boxes from the inside out: natural numbers sit inside integers, then rational numbers, then real numbers. Minus three is an integer, one half is rational, and square root of two is irrational. Each enclosing set also contains the numbers in its smaller boxes.

task: Choose union, intersection or complement
formula: ∪: either; ∩: both; A′=U∖A; n(A′)=n(U)−n(A). ∪ and ∩ are commutative and associative.
condition: Union includes overlap. The complement depends on U.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Choose union, intersection or complement. The shared lens means membership in both sets: the intersection."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="24" y="16" width="432" height="150" rx="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#bbcbd2" stroke-width="2" /><circle cx="198" cy="95" r="63" fill="none" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="282" cy="95" r="63" fill="none" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M240 48 A63 63 0 0 1 240 142 A63 63 0 0 1 240 48" stroke="#087f75" fill="#b8ddcf" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="74.25" y="50.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">U</text><text x="172.0" y="51.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">A</text><text x="308.0" y="51.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">B</text><text x="186.45" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">A only</text><text x="240.0" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">both</text><text x="296.1" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">B only</text></svg>
narration: The shared lens means membership in both sets: the intersection. The union includes both circles, including this shared part. The complement of A is everything in the universal box outside A. Union and intersection can be swapped or regrouped without changing their result.

task: Find A but not B
formula: A∖B = A∩B′.
condition: Difference is generally neither commutative nor associative.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Find A but not B. Keep the part of A lying outside B."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="24" y="16" width="432" height="150" rx="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#bbcbd2" stroke-width="2" /><circle cx="198" cy="95" r="63" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="282" cy="95" r="63" fill="#fff" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="74.25" y="50.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">U</text><text x="172.0" y="51.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">A</text><text x="308.0" y="51.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">B</text><text x="186.45" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">keep</text><text x="240.0" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle" /><text x="296.1" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle" /></svg>
narration: Keep the part of A lying outside B. The overlapping part is removed because its members also belong to B. Swapping the set names would keep a different crescent. Unlike union and intersection, set difference cannot generally be swapped or regrouped without changing the answer.

task: Fill a three-set diagram from the centre
formula: AB-only=n(A∩B)−n(A∩B∩C). n(A∪B∪C)=n(A)+n(B)+n(C)−n(A∩B)−n(A∩C)−n(B∩C)+n(A∩B∩C).
condition: Pair intersections include the centre unless “only” is specified.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Fill a three-set diagram from the centre. Begin with the centre shared by all three sets."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><circle cx="196" cy="80" r="63" fill="none" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="284" cy="80" r="63" fill="none" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="240" cy="118" r="52" fill="none" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="240" cy="93" r="15" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="366" y1="77" x2="302" y2="90" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M308.11668296897284,84.84382026524698 L302,90 L309.64363355164954,92.36111544150161" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="156.7" y="48.0" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">A</text><text x="324.15" y="48.0" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">B</text><text x="295.25" y="150.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">C</text><text x="240.0" y="99.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="240.0" y="55.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="172.0" y="107.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="372.6" y="68.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">centre</text></svg>

task: Find a missing region or total
formula: Disjoint regions add once. Union = n(U) − outside.
condition: Counts of people must be non-negative integers.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Find a missing region or total. Each disjoint region represents different people, so count every region exactly once."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="24" y="16" width="432" height="150" rx="5" fill="#fff" stroke="#bbcbd2" stroke-width="2" /><circle cx="198" cy="95" r="63" fill="none" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="282" cy="95" r="63" fill="none" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="74.25" y="50.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">U</text><text x="172.0" y="51.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">A</text><text x="308.0" y="51.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">B</text><text x="186.45" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="240.0" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">x</text><text x="296.1" y="101.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="378.55" y="137.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="240.0" y="159.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">n(U)=20: 5+x+7+4=20</text></svg>
narration: Each disjoint region represents different people, so count every region exactly once. Here the universal total is twenty, with five on the left, seven on the right and four outside. The unknown overlap must therefore be four. Check that the result fits every stated total.

task: Find the smallest or largest overlap
formula: max(0,a+b−N) ≤ overlap ≤ min(a,b); union=a+b−overlap.
condition: a and b are set sizes inside a universe of size N.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Find the smallest or largest overlap. Twelve plus eleven counts twenty-three memberships in a universe of only twenty people, forcing at least three people into both sets."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><line x1="47" y1="95" x2="433" y2="95" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M425.97933950487703,98.83540430883363 L433,95 L425.97933950487703,91.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="65.0" y1="88" x2="65.0" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="152.5" y1="88" x2="152.5" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="240.0" y1="88" x2="240.0" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="327.5" y1="88" x2="327.5" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="415.0" y1="88" x2="415.0" y2="102" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><circle cx="65.0" cy="95" r="7" fill="#b96a12" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="65" y1="76" x2="415" y2="76" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="5" /></g><text x="240.0" y="40.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">N=20, a=12, b=11</text><text x="91.25" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3</text><text x="165.625" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">5</text><text x="240.0" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">7</text><text x="314.375" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">9</text><text x="388.75" y="124.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">11</text><text x="240.0" y="155.95" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">overlap can range from 3 to 11</text></svg>
narration: Twelve plus eleven counts twenty-three memberships in a universe of only twenty people, forcing at least three people into both sets. At the other end, no overlap can exceed the smaller set, eleven. These two limits give the entire feasible range before any extra conditions are applied.

task: Distinguish people from memberships
formula: Union=E₁+E₂+E₃. Membership total=E₁+2E₂+3E₃.
condition: Eₖ counts people in exactly k sets; apply ratios to named regions.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Distinguish people from memberships. Each circle represents one person."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><circle cx="80" cy="65" r="19" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="240" cy="65" r="19" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><circle cx="400" cy="65" r="19" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="104.0" y="76.05" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="240.0" y="76.05" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="376.0" y="76.05" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">1</text><text x="104.0" y="109.2" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">1 set</text><text x="240.0" y="109.2" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">2 sets</text><text x="376.0" y="109.2" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">3 sets</text><text x="240.0" y="150.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">3 people → 1+2+3 = 6 memberships</text></svg>
narration: Each circle represents one person. The first joins one set, the second joins two and the third joins three. There are still only three people in the union, but six memberships altogether. Use this distinction when combining totals, percentages or ratios of exclusive regions.

task: Move forwards or backwards through a percentage
formula: New=old(1±r/100); old=new/(1±r/100).
condition: Reverse using the same non-zero multiplier.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Move forwards or backwards through a percentage. The forward arrow multiplies the original amount by one plus or minus the percentage as a decimal."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="35" y="55" width="141" height="67" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="303" y="55" width="141" height="67" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="185" y1="70" x2="294" y2="70" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M286.97933950487703,73.83540430883363 L294,70 L286.97933950487703,66.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="294" y1="113" x2="185" y2="113" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M192.02066049512297,109.16459569116637 L185,113 L192.02066049512297,116.83540430883362" stroke="#3175ba" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="126.1" y="96.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">old</text><text x="353.05" y="96.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">new</text><text x="240.0" y="51.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">× multiplier</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">÷ same multiplier</text></svg>
narration: The forward arrow multiplies the original amount by one plus or minus the percentage as a decimal. To recover the original, follow the backward arrow and divide by that exact multiplier. The percentage belongs to the original base, so subtracting it from the final amount is not the reverse operation.

task: Choose the correct profit percentage base
formula: Profit=S−C; markup%=100×profit/C; margin%=100×profit/S; loss%=100×loss/C.
condition: C=cost, S=selling price. Markup uses C; margin uses S.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Choose the correct profit percentage base. The selling price contains the cost plus profit."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="40" y="42" width="250" height="55" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="290" y="42" width="150" height="55" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="40" y1="115" x2="440" y2="115" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="3" /></g><text x="176.25" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">cost C</text><text x="346.25" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">profit</text><text x="240.0" y="139.8" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">selling price S = whole bar</text></svg>
narration: The selling price contains the cost plus profit. Markup compares the profit part with the cost part, while margin compares it with the entire selling-price bar. A loss percentage uses the cost as its base. Name the denominator before entering numbers into the percentage calculation.

task: Charge each usage band separately
formula: Subtotal = fixed charge + Σ(band units × band rate).
condition: Only the units inside a band receive that band’s rate.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Charge each usage band separately. Cut the total usage at every threshold."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="35" y="45" width="160" height="61" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="195" y="45" width="130" height="61" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="325" y="45" width="120" height="61" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="133.75" y="76.05" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">first units</text><text x="133.75" y="97.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">× rate 1</text><text x="257.0" y="76.05" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">next units</text><text x="257.0" y="97.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">× rate 2</text><text x="363.25" y="76.05" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">rest</text><text x="363.25" y="97.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">× rate 3</text><text x="240.0" y="145.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Add the bands + fixed charge.</text></svg>
narration: Cut the total usage at every threshold. Each coloured band has its own unit count and rate, so calculate those charges separately and add them. Include any fixed charge as an additional amount. A higher final band does not normally change the price of units in earlier bands.

task: Build gross pay from its parts
formula: Gross pay = basic pay + overtime pay + commission.
condition: Apply each hours or sales rate only within its own band.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Build gross pay from its parts. The three blocks represent separate sources of earnings."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="24" y="56" width="164" height="66" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="194" y="56" width="129" height="66" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="329" y="56" width="127" height="66" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="24" y1="140" x2="456" y2="140" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="126.1" y="95.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">basic</text><text x="255.3" y="95.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">overtime</text><text x="369.2" y="95.6" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">sales</text><text x="240.0" y="40.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">GROSS PAY</text><text x="240.0" y="158.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Add the separate earnings.</text></svg>
narration: The three blocks represent separate sources of earnings. Calculate basic hours at the basic rate, overtime hours at the stated overtime rate, and each commission band from its own sales amount. Add these components to get gross pay before subtracting any deductions or taxes.

task: Apply supplied tax bands and credits
formula: Gross tax=Σ(band income×rate); income tax=max(0,gross tax−credits); net=gross−all deductions.
condition: Calculate USC and PRSI separately using the question’s rules.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Apply supplied tax bands and credits. First calculate the income tax generated by each band and add it."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="16.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="152.0" y1="83" x2="170.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M162.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L170.0,83 L162.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="174.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="310.0" y1="83" x2="328.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M320.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L328.0,83 L320.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="332.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="105.7" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">band</text><text x="105.7" y="102.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">taxes</text><text x="240.0" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">less</text><text x="240.0" y="102.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">credits</text><text x="374.3" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">income</text><text x="374.3" y="102.4" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">tax ≥ 0</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Subtract all deductions from gross pay.</text></svg>
narration: First calculate the income tax generated by each band and add it. Credits reduce that total, but payable income tax cannot fall below zero. Other deductions such as USC or PRSI have their own supplied rules. Subtract every applicable deduction from gross pay to find net pay.

task: Work backwards from net pay or tax paid
formula: Within one band: write net as a function of gross. Fully used credit=gross tax−income tax paid.
condition: At zero income tax, an unused larger credit cannot be determined uniquely.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Work backwards from net pay or tax paid. Move backwards from the known net amount by writing an equation for deductions in the relevant band."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="38" y="64" width="165" height="54" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="277" y="64" width="165" height="54" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="267" y1="91" x2="214" y2="91" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M221.02066049512297,87.16459569116637 L214,91 L221.02066049512297,94.83540430883362" stroke="#3175ba" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="240.0" y="40.35" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="27" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">gross − deductions = net</text><text x="138.0" y="98.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="27" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">gross ?</text><text x="342.0" y="98.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="24" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">net known</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Solve, then check the tax band.</text></svg>
narration: Move backwards from the known net amount by writing an equation for deductions in the relevant band. Solve for gross, then check that the answer really lies in that band. A tax bill of zero alone cannot reveal an exact credit if some of the credit was unused.

task: Convert currency in the right direction
formula: If €1=£r: pounds=euro×r; euro=pounds/r, with r>0.
condition: Apply fees at the stated stage and in the stated currency.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Convert currency in the right direction. The quoted rate tells you how many pounds each euro buys."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="35" y="55" width="140" height="68" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="305" y="55" width="140" height="68" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="185" y1="69" x2="295" y2="69" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M287.97933950487703,72.83540430883363 L295,69 L287.97933950487703,65.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="295" y1="113" x2="185" y2="113" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M192.02066049512297,109.16459569116637 L185,113 L192.02066049512297,116.83540430883362" stroke="#b96a12" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="125.25" y="97.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">euro</text><text x="354.75" y="97.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">pounds</text><text x="240.0" y="48.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">× r</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">÷ r</text></svg>
narration: The quoted rate tells you how many pounds each euro buys. Multiply euros by that pounds-per-euro rate to move forwards, and divide pounds by the rate to return to euros. A fee must be deducted or added in the currency and at the stage stated in the question.

task: Repeat a growth or depreciation multiplier
formula: A=P(1+r/100)ⁿ; depreciation A=P(1−r/100)ⁿ.
condition: Match rate and period; apply each change to the current amount.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Repeat a growth or depreciation multiplier. Each arrow acts on the balance left by the previous period."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="16.0" y="48" width="92.5" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="112.5" y1="83" x2="130.5" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M123.47933950487702,86.83540430883363 L130.5,83 L123.47933950487702,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="134.5" y="48" width="92.5" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="231.0" y1="83" x2="249.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M241.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L249.0,83 L241.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="253.0" y="48" width="92.5" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="349.5" y1="83" x2="367.5" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M360.47933950487703,86.83540430883363 L367.5,83 L360.47933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="371.5" y="48" width="92.5" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="88.912" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">P</text><text x="189.637" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">× m</text><text x="290.362" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">× m</text><text x="391.087" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">A</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Repeat the multiplier n times.</text></svg>
narration: Each arrow acts on the balance left by the previous period. For growth the multiplier is greater than one; for depreciation it is less than one. Repeating the same multiplier n times creates a power. A fixed percentage therefore changes the cash amount differently in each period.

task: Put rate changes and transactions in order
formula: A=(P m₁−W+D)m₂.
condition: W and D occur after period 1 here; follow the actual timing.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Put rate changes and transactions in order. Work along the timeline."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="16.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="152.0" y1="83" x2="170.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M162.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L170.0,83 L162.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="174.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="310.0" y1="83" x2="328.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M320.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L328.0,83 L320.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="332.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="105.7" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">P × m₁</text><text x="240.0" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">−W +D</text><text x="374.3" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">× m₂</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">balance 1 → transaction → balance 2</text></svg>
narration: Work along the timeline. Apply the first multiplier, then make the withdrawal or deposit, and only then apply the second multiplier. The amount present during a period determines the interest for that period. Adding the rates or moving a transaction to another stage changes the result.

task: Recover the principal or repeated rate
formula: P=A/(m₁m₂…); equal periods: m=(A/P)^(1/n). Growth r=100(m−1)%; depreciation r=100(1−m)%.
condition: Use positive balances; distinguish a multiplier from a percentage.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Recover the principal or repeated rate. The complete forward journey multiplies the principal by every period’s multiplier."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="16.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="152.0" y1="83" x2="170.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M162.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L170.0,83 L162.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="174.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="310.0" y1="83" x2="328.0" y2="83" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M320.97933950487703,86.83540430883363 L328.0,83 L320.97933950487703,79.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="332.0" y="48" width="132.0" height="70" rx="5" fill="#f0f7f6" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="105.7" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">P</text><text x="240.0" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">× mⁿ</text><text x="374.3" y="80.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">A</text><text x="240.0" y="147.45" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Reverse with division or an nth root.</text></svg>
narration: The complete forward journey multiplies the principal by every period’s multiplier. Divide by that product to recover the starting balance. If the same rate repeats, take the nth root of final divided by initial to find the multiplier, then convert the multiplier into a growth or depreciation percentage.

task: Tax the interest, not the principal
formula: Net interest=P×r×(1−t), with decimal rates r and t.
condition: Interest tax applies to interest; retain the principal separately.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Tax the interest, not the principal. The principal stays as the large block."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="30" y="42" width="300" height="61" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /><rect x="342" y="42" width="108" height="61" rx="5" fill="#edf4fc" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="396" y1="110" x2="396" y2="134" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M392.16459569116637,126.97933950487702 L396,134 L399.83540430883363,126.97933950487702" stroke="#b96a12" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="189.0" y="82.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="28" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">principal P</text><text x="372.6" y="82.0" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">P×r</text><text x="240.0" y="152.55" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Keep interest × (1−t); principal stays.</text></svg>
narration: The principal stays as the large block. Only the interest, P times the decimal rate r, is taxed. Retain one minus the tax rate of that interest and then add it to the principal if a final balance is requested. Do not subtract interest tax from the whole balance.

task: Choose the variable and data type
formula: Population: target group. Variable: recorded feature. Categorical=labels; discrete=counts; continuous=measurements.
condition: Rounding a measurement does not turn it into a count variable.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Choose the variable and data type. The target group is the population. The underlying variable determines the data type, even when a measurement has been rounded for recording.

task: Repair a biased questionnaire
formula: Use neutral wording, one idea at a time, and a precise reference period.
condition: Avoid leading language and questions that ask two things at once.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Repair a biased questionnaire. The upper question assumes that the person loves maths, steering the response."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><rect x="27" y="20" width="426" height="50" rx="5" fill="#fff3dd" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="240" y1="75" x2="240" y2="100" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M236.16459569116637,92.97933950487702 L240,100 L243.83540430883363,92.97933950487702" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><rect x="27" y="110" width="426" height="50" rx="5" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2" /></g><text x="240.0" y="58.2" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">“How much do you love maths?”</text><text x="240.0" y="134.7" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">“How do you feel about maths?”</text></svg>
narration: The upper question assumes that the person loves maths, steering the response. The revised question allows a range of feelings without assuming an answer. For quantities such as study time, also state a clear reference period and avoid combining two separate topics in one question.

task: Give every response exactly one home
formula: Response categories must be exhaustive and mutually exclusive.
condition: Use inequalities or clear boundaries so endpoints belong once.

The intervals cover all allowed values from zero to thirty, with no shared ownership of an endpoint."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><line x1="57" y1="100" x2="423" y2="100" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2.5" /><path d="M415.97933950487703,103.83540430883363 L423,100 L415.97933950487703,96.16459569116637" stroke="#173349" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="75.0" y1="93" x2="75.0" y2="107" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="185.0" y1="93" x2="185.0" y2="107" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="295.0" y1="93" x2="295.0" y2="107" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="405.0" y1="93" x2="405.0" y2="107" stroke="#173349" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="75" y1="69" x2="185" y2="69" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="6" /><line x1="185" y1="57" x2="295" y2="57" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="6" /><line x1="295" y1="45" x2="405" y2="45" stroke="#b96a12" stroke-width="6" /></g><text x="99.75" y="128.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">0</text><text x="193.25" y="128.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">10</text><text x="286.75" y="128.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">20</text><text x="380.25" y="128.75" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">30</text><text x="240.0" y="157.65" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">0≤x<10 | 10≤x<20 | 20≤x≤30</text></svg>

task: Turn counts into relative frequencies
formula: Relative frequency=f/N; percentage=100f/N.
condition: N counts observations, not categories.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Turn counts into relative frequencies. task: Take a proportional sample
formula: Group sample = total sample × group population / total population.
condition: After allocating quotas, select fairly within each group.

This preserves the proportions, but you must still choose fairly within each group rather than selecting only convenient people.

task: Split a composite shape into familiar pieces
formula: Rectangle: A=lw, P=2(l+w). Trapezium: A=(a+b)h/2. Kite/rhombus: A=d₁d₂/2. Add/subtract non-overlapping areas.
condition: Trace only the outer boundary; h and the two diagonals must be perpendicular as required.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Split a composite shape into familiar pieces. The dashed line splits the L-shaped region into two rectangles without overlap."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><polygon points="45,30 270,30 270,85 420,85 420,149 45,149" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="270" y1="85" x2="270" y2="149" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 5" /></g><text x="167.75" y="99.85" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="22" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">rectangle 1</text><text x="329.25" y="120.25" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="25" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="240.0" y="161.9" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#173349" text-anchor="middle">Area: add pieces. Perimeter: trace outside.</text></svg>
narration: The dashed line splits the L-shaped region into two rectangles without overlap. Add their areas, but do not count the internal dashed line in the perimeter. Other questions may need a trapezium or diagonal-based kite formula. Match each formula to its required parallel or perpendicular measurements.

task: Use the perpendicular height
formula: Parallelogram A=bh; triangle A=bh/2.
condition: h meets the base at 90°; a sloping side is not the height.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Use the perpendicular height. The blue dashed height drops at a right angle to the base."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><polygon points="49,140 281,140 408,35 176,35" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke="#087f75" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="176" y1="35" x2="176" y2="140" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="5 5" /><path d="M176 125 L191 125 L191 140" stroke="#3175ba" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" /></g><text x="169.45" y="93.9" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">h</text><text x="177.1" y="158.5" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#087f75" text-anchor="middle">b</text><text x="318.2" y="93.05" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="20" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">sloping</text></svg>
narration: The blue dashed height drops at a right angle to the base. Sliding the sloping portion would make a rectangle of the same base and height, so the parallelogram’s area is base times height. A triangle with the same base and height occupies half that area.

task: Choose a circular area or boundary formula
formula: C=2πr; A=πr². Arc=(θ/360)2πr; sector A=(θ/360)πr²; sector P=2r+arc. Semicircle A=πr²/2, P=πr+2r.
condition: Sector 0<θ<360°. Count straight radii/diameters only when exposed.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 180" role="img" aria-label="Choose a circular area or boundary formula. The sector’s curved part is a fraction of the whole circumference, controlled by its central angle."><rect width="480" height="180" fill="#ffffff" /><g transform="translate(36 14) scale(0.85)"><path d="M90 134 L90 42 A92 92 0 0 1 182 134 Z" stroke="#087f75" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="90" y1="134" x2="182" y2="134" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="3" /><path d="M284 134 A82 82 0 0 1 448 134 Z" stroke="#087f75" fill="#e8f5f1" stroke-width="2.5" /><line x1="284" y1="134" x2="448" y2="134" stroke="#3175ba" stroke-width="3" /></g><text x="148.2" y="149.15" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">r</text><text x="101.45" y="92.2" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="26" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">r</text><text x="132.9" y="114.3" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="23" fill="#b96a12" text-anchor="middle">θ</text><text x="347.1" y="151.7" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="21" fill="#3175ba" text-anchor="middle">diameter = 2r</text></svg>
